cases.importValidation: Use up to 30 messages in one booking brief.

fix: Invalid explicit calendar dates are kept only as unresolved constraints, without a booking date value. Valid date corrections resolve normally.
limitations: Synthetic functional cases do not replace feedback from real users.
Download was clicked, but the in-app browser did not expose a completion event; native file delivery remains unverified.
evidenceNotes: All raw iterations retained, including the premature automation wait and the failing impossible-date case.
E14 uses Reviewed for a staff override, verifies Staff edit attribution and the expanded conflict note.
The final 35 contiguous runs occurred after the new deployment was READY. The original runner hardcoded phase initial; these final run labels were corrected after execution.
